headline.text: Seven Feastables *60g molds* found mixed into ML4 snack-size tote — caught during mold inspection, removed from line before use.

summary: One active hold for label rework on S2. Cross-contact event at ML4 caught by operators. Multiple quality flags across L3 — glycol level low, centerlines off-spec, vendor belt quality driving TG3 rejects. Sanitation gaps driving equipment issues: glue buildup tearing film on ML3, operator spill on ML4 depositor check.

holds.title: S2 label rework — incorrect best by dates
holds.summary: Two pallets item 30732 with wrong best-by dates on box labels placed in rework status by packaging supervisor.

food_safety.title: Feastables molds mixed into snack-size totes
food_safety.summary: Seven 60g Feastables molds found in ML4 snack-size mold totes during pre-insertion inspection — operators removing all before magazine load.
food_safety.status: Operators inspecting every mold before insertion; no foreign molds entered production.

quality.title: S3 caramel soft at pack due to tunnel temps
quality.summary: Soft caramel observed in pack area — cooling tunnel 2 temps high, chiller settings missing from recipe loaded at startup.
quality.status: Resolved — chiller settings corrected and saved to recipe, product firming up.

quality.title: ML1 display boxes missing adhesive
quality.summary: Display boxes found with no adhesive on bottom fold — quality notified, investigating batch.
quality.status: Open — team tracking count of affected boxes through end of shift.

quality.title: ML4 TG5 film tears — forming fin damage
quality.summary: TG5 cutting film due to ridge on south forming fin — maintenance smoothed ridge, running clean since 01:33.
quality.status: Resolved — forming fin corrected, no further tears.

quality.title: ML4 TG3 rejecting product — vendor belt issue
quality.summary: TG3 270 belts folding at edges causing product rejects — TG techs identified wrong vendor, will replace belts and reorder from OEM.
quality.status: Open — running with rejects until belt change; Nelson ordering correct vendor stock.

quality.title: ML1 glycol level below spec
quality.summary: Glycol measured at 1.2 vs 1.5 target — maintenance contacted to refill, potential impact on cooling performance.
quality.status: Maintenance addressing; waiting for confirmation of correction.

quality.title: S4 salt distribution flagged then cleared
quality.summary: Quality flagged heavy salt on some pieces at startup — kitchen adjusted, follow-up check confirmed within spec.
quality.status: Resolved — salt distribution confirmed acceptable after adjustment.

quality.title: S2 jar label quality — wrinkling and bubbles
quality.summary: Label applicator producing wrinkled labels with bubbles along bottom edge — maintenance adjusted 30 min, issue persists.
quality.status: Open — running with cosmetic defect; maintenance escalating to vendor for root cause.

quality.title: ML1 centerlines off-spec at shift start
quality.summary: Nine centerline parameters out of spec on old sheet at 2nd shift handoff — operator working adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved — adjustments completed, line running within spec by mid-shift.

sanitation.title: ML3 vacuum cleaning reminder — CIL gap
sanitation.summary: Shift handoff note that vacuums not being left clean during CIL — impacting all shifts, causing line stops and extended CIL times.
sanitation.status: Open — supervisor reminder posted to all shifts; monitoring compliance.

sanitation.title: ML3 film tears — glue buildup on rollers
sanitation.summary: Flow-wrap film tearing repeatedly at forming station — glue residue found on rollers driving failures.
sanitation.status: Open — operators cleaning rollers; recurring issue suggests cleaning frequency gap.

sanitation.title: ML4 Dep 2 spill — filter checked while running
sanitation.summary: Operator checked depositor filter during equipment operation per startup checklist step 2, causing product spill — supervisor requesting checklist update to clarify shutdown required.
sanitation.status: Open — Shawn acknowledged good callout; checklist revision pending.

sanitation.title: Truffle flavor pipe clogged
sanitation.summary: Flavor delivery pipe clogged with chocolate and crystallized sugar — maintenance disassembled and cleaning sections, delaying startup.
sanitation.status: Open — final section being washed; root cause of contamination under review.

allergen.title: S2 allergen containers in non-allergen area
allergen.summary: Red allergen-labeled containers found staged in S2 production area during non-allergen MMK jar run — QA flagged for removal.
allergen.status: Resolved — containers relocated by production team after QA notification.

opportunities.text: Review S3 recipe save/load procedure — today's soft caramel from missing chiller settings suggests recipe integrity check needed at line start.
Review ML3 vacuum cleaning standards and add to CIL verification checklist — today's shift handoff notes that dirty vacuums are impacting all three shifts with line stops and extended CIL.
Consider adding 'equipment must be stopped' callout to ML4 Depositor 2 startup checklist step 2 (filter check) — today's spill from checking filter while running echoes procedure ambiguity.
Add mold visual inspection step to ML4 startup checklist before magazine loading — today's seven Feastables molds in snack-size totes were caught only because operator chose to inspect.
Consider adding TG belt vendor and part number to ML4 spare parts spec — today's TG3 reject issue traced to wrong vendor belt purchased outside OEM channel.
